meta.title: perf: optimize .tz() calls with proper timezone detection
meta.body_summary: Optimized slot generation by reducing expensive .tz() timezone conversions inside loops and improving timezone detection, especially for IST and 45-minute intervals.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to reduce .tz() calls in slot generation but the approach was judged not performance-focused; PR closed after ~8h with no human review, only DevinAI bot self-closure.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 393 changed lines in a single file, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. As a performance PR it was closed without merge because the maintainer indicated the approach was not properly focused on performance optimization.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR's approach was still not properly focused on performance optimization, as stated by the closing bot comment, likely after maintainer dissatisfaction.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce expensive .tz() calls in loops (0.053ms-0.097ms each) to improve slot generation performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Devin AI bot closed the PR, stating the approach was not properly focused on performance optimization.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Timezone micro-optimization in a complex scheduling module requires clear performance evidence and focused changes; Devin's PR was deemed not properly optimized for performance.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body cites micro-benchmark numbers but provides no reproducible benchmark results or testing steps for performance validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after maintainer (via bot) deemed approach not properly focused on performance.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/lib/slots.ts, modified the buildSlotsWithDateRanges function to minimize .tz() calls by keeping calculations in UTC and converting to timezone only when necessary; added IST timezone detection and 45-minute interval handling.
